albums_cover_source_check.name: albums_cover_source_check
albums_cover_source_check.value: cover_url is null or cover_source is not null

artists_photo_attribution_check.name: artists_photo_attribution_check
artists_photo_attribution_check.value: photo_url is null or (photo_credit is not null and photo_license is not null)

artists_photo_provenance_check.name: artists_photo_provenance_check
artists_photo_provenance_check.value: (photo_url is null) = (photo_file_sha1 is null) and (photo_url is null) = (photo_file_timestamp is null) and (photo_url is null) = (photo_chosen_at is null)

auth_accounts_credential_only_check.name: auth_accounts_credential_only_check
auth_accounts_credential_only_check.value: provider_id = 'credential' and password is not null

entry_slugs_retired_check.name: entry_slugs_retired_check
entry_slugs_retired_check.value: entry_id is not null or (was_published and not is_current)

entry_texts_first_published_at_check.name: entry_texts_first_published_at_check

entry_texts_first_published_order_check.name: entry_texts_first_published_order_check
entry_texts_first_published_order_check.value: published_at is null or first_published_at <= published_at

entry_texts_body_is_document_check.name: entry_texts_body_is_document_check
entry_texts_body_is_document_check.value: body is null or (jsonb_typeof(body) = 'object' and body ->> 'type' = 'doc')

entry_texts_body_text_requires_body_chec.name: entry_texts_body_text_requires_body_check
entry_texts_body_text_requires_body_chec.value: body is not null or body_text = ''

track_reflection_texts_body_is_document_.name: track_reflection_texts_body_is_document_check
track_reflection_texts_body_is_document_.value: body is null or (jsonb_typeof(body) = 'object' and body ->> 'type' = 'doc')

track_reflection_texts_body_text_require.name: track_reflection_texts_body_text_requires_body_check
track_reflection_texts_body_text_require.value: body is not null or body_text = ''
